hunks.baseline: I didn’t need to think about how to move. A picture formed naturally in my mind, and my hands moved at the same time as my thoughts.
hunks.sol: I didn’t need to think about how to move. The answer came to me naturally, and my hands moved as soon as the thought formed.

hunks.baseline: Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron was hard and sharp enough to destroy Body-Protecting Qi on its own. Once Spear Energy was added to the mix, the result was obvious.
hunks.sol: Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron was hard and sharp enough to destroy Body-Protecting Qi on its own. With Spear Energy added to it, the result was only natural.

hunks.baseline: “Gasp!”
hunks.sol: “Hhk!”

hunks.baseline: The Black Hunter closest to me let out a hollow gasp as he stared at his sword, which had melted under the Fire Gate Divine Technique’s flames.
hunks.sol: The closest Black Hunter gasped as he stared at his sword, melted by the fiery qi of the Fire Gate Divine Technique.

hunks.baseline: My grip could crush stone and rebar. When I tightened my fingers around his forearm, his flesh was mangled and his bone burst through.
hunks.sol: My grip could crush stone and rebar. When I tightened my fingers around his forearm, his flesh was mangled and bone burst through.

hunks.baseline: I had memorized the descriptions of the men who had attacked Im Kkeokjeong. I stared intently at the Black Hunter’s face as he screamed in agony.
hunks.sol: I had memorized the descriptions of every man who had attacked Im Kkeokjeong. I stared intently at the Black Hunter’s face as he screamed in agony.

hunks.baseline: A dagger shot up beneath my chin with a venomous cry. Even in the middle of his pain, he didn’t hesitate in the slightest.
hunks.sol: With a venomous shout, he drove a dagger up beneath my chin. Even in that much pain, his hand didn’t hesitate.

hunks.baseline: This wasn’t the movement of someone in a raid.
hunks.sol: This wasn’t how someone moved in a raid.

hunks.baseline: It was the movement of a skilled killer.
hunks.sol: These were the movements of a skilled killer.

hunks.baseline: *I tried to reason with people like these.*
hunks.sol: *And I tried to reason with people like these.*

hunks.baseline: I reflected on it once again.
*I really was a fucking idiot.*
hunks.sol: Once again, I reflected on what a fucking idiot I’d been.

hunks.baseline: No, I tore it off.
hunks.sol: No—I tore them off.

hunks.baseline: His mouth stretched wide, but the pain was so great that he couldn’t even scream.
hunks.sol: His mouth gaped wide, but the pain was too great for him to scream.

hunks.baseline: I kicked the man in the back as his limbs trembled violently. Along with his breath, which came in gasps that sounded ready to break, blood gushed from the torn stumps.
hunks.sol: I kicked him in the back as his whole body convulsed. He gasped raggedly, barely clinging to life, while blood gushed from the torn stumps.

hunks.baseline: I tossed the two arms separated from their owner’s body onto the lawn.
hunks.sol: I tossed both arms onto the lawn.

hunks.baseline: A heavy silence descended over the area.
hunks.sol: A heavy silence descended over the yard.

hunks.baseline: The Black Hunters hesitated after watching one of their companions, someone around their level, get taken down in an instant. Im Yeongjun, who had been watching everything from behind them, twitched his eyebrows.
hunks.sol: The Black Hunters faltered after seeing a comrade on their level taken apart in an instant. Behind them, Im Yeongjun’s eyebrows twitched as he watched.

hunks.baseline: “Yeah. That’s why I came. But it doesn’t look like you have anything.”
hunks.sol: “Yeah. That’s why I came. You don’t seem to have anything, though.”

hunks.baseline: “You should’ve listened while I was asking nicely. Because of you and the other two, this guy can’t even jerk off by himself anymore.”
hunks.sol: “You should’ve listened while I was asking nicely. Because of you and the other two, this bastard can’t even jerk off by himself anymore.”

hunks.baseline: I swept my gaze around in a dry voice. Every time my eyes passed over someone, a wave of emotions rippled through them—anger mixed with confusion.
hunks.sol: My voice remained flat as I swept my gaze around. Wherever my eyes passed, anger and confusion churned across their faces.

hunks.baseline: Im Yeongjun read the atmosphere and shouted furiously.
hunks.sol: Sensing the shift in the atmosphere, Im Yeongjun glared and roared.

hunks.baseline: “What are you waiting for, you bastards?! I’ll save every one of you, even if I have to shower you in potions! Don’t be scared—beat him to death!”
hunks.sol: “What are you waiting for, you bastards?! I’ll save every last one of you even if I have to bathe you in potions! Don’t be afraid—beat him to death!”

hunks.baseline: “If someone loses both arms, you’d need high-grade potions at the very least. You must have a lot of money.”
hunks.sol: “If you lose an arm or a leg, you’d need at least a high-grade potion. You guys must be loaded.”

hunks.baseline: “If you think of it as the cost of removing a major obstacle, it isn’t wasteful. We should have eliminated you from the beginning, but… I didn’t like the order from the moment I received it.”
hunks.sol: “If that’s what it costs to remove one major obstacle, it’s worth every penny. We should’ve eliminated you from the start… I never liked the order we were given.”

hunks.baseline: “Isn’t it a bad idea to blab so openly about having someone powerful behind you? Won’t they kill you to silence you?”
hunks.sol: “Should you really be blabbing about having someone powerful behind you? Aren’t you worried they’ll kill you to silence you?”

hunks.baseline: A sneer formed at the corners of Im Yeongjun’s mouth.
hunks.sol: A sneer spread across Im Yeongjun’s lips.

hunks.baseline: “We’re the ones who kill people to silence them. And either way, you’re going to die here.”
hunks.sol: “We’re the ones who silence witnesses. Besides, you’re going to die here anyway.”

hunks.baseline: “Sure, let’s put that aside for now. There’s something I’ve been wondering about.”
hunks.sol: “Sure, let’s put that aside for now. There’s something I’ve been wondering.”

hunks.baseline: I asked sincerely,
hunks.sol: I asked with complete sincerity.

hunks.baseline: “That potion you use—can it bring dead people back to life, too? Or do you carry three or four extra lives around with you?”
hunks.sol: “Those potions of yours—can they bring the dead back to life? Or do you carry three or four spare lives around?”

hunks.baseline: The spear answered in his place. The Black Hunter groaning at my feet lost his head.
hunks.sol: The spear answered for him. The Black Hunter groaning at my feet lost his head.

hunks.baseline: I casually kicked the head separated from his body and sent it rolling toward the others.
hunks.sol: I gave the severed head a light kick, sending it rolling toward the others.

hunks.baseline: “Try saving him.”
hunks.sol: “Go on. Save him.”

hunks.baseline: “Right. If someone’s heart bursts or their head comes off, even a potion can’t bring them back.”
hunks.sol: “Oh, right. Even potions can’t save you if your heart bursts or your head comes off.”

hunks.baseline: The two daggers shot out at a terrifying speed and became flashes of light.
hunks.sol: Two daggers shot out with terrifying speed, becoming flashes of light.

hunks.baseline: Unable to withstand the internal energy carried by the daggers, half of each corpse’s head had been blown away.
hunks.sol: Their bodies had been unable to withstand the internal energy carried by the daggers. Half of each man’s head was gone.

hunks.baseline: “Ah. I was trying to plant them neatly between their eyebrows, but I couldn’t control my strength.”
hunks.sol: “Ah. I was trying to plant them neatly between the eyebrows, but I couldn’t control my strength.”

hunks.baseline: The sneer had vanished completely from Im Yeongjun’s lips. A tempest now raged in the eyes of the Black Hunters, whose number had been reduced to twenty-five.
hunks.sol: The sneer had vanished from Im Yeongjun’s lips. A tempest now raged in the eyes of the remaining twenty-five Black Hunters.

hunks.baseline: “H-How?”
hunks.sol: “H-How…?”

hunks.baseline: “Goddamn it…”
hunks.sol: “What the fuck…?”

hunks.baseline: Suppressed groans rose from here and there. It was something they had never experienced before.
hunks.sol: Suppressed groans came from all around. They had probably never experienced anything like this.

hunks.baseline: Murder, kidnapping, blackmail, and every other filthy task—they had served as the enforcers of a major Guild.
hunks.sol: Murder, kidnapping, blackmail, and every other filthy job—they had served as enforcers for a major Guild.

hunks.baseline: But they had clearly never imagined being hunted themselves.
hunks.sol: But they had clearly never imagined that they might be hunted themselves.

hunks.baseline: They certainly hadn’t imagined being hunted so one-sidedly.
hunks.sol: Much less that it would be this one-sided.

hunks.baseline: I spat phlegm onto the headless corpse.
hunks.sol: I spat on the headless corpse.

hunks.baseline: “You bastards are like dark-path knife fighters.”
hunks.sol: “You’re nothing but dark-path thugs with swords.”

hunks.baseline: No. In terms of their mindset, dark-path knife fighters were actually better.
hunks.sol: No. When it came to their mindset, even dark-path thugs were better than these bastards.

hunks.baseline: At least those men were prepared for the possibility that they might someday be stabbed to death in a back alley.
hunks.sol: At least those men accepted that they might someday be stabbed to death in a back alley.

hunks.baseline: His voice was dry, as though all the moisture had been sucked out of it.
hunks.sol: His voice was bone-dry, reflecting the turmoil inside him.

hunks.baseline: “You already know, so why ask?”
hunks.sol: “You already know. Why bother asking?”

hunks.baseline: His gaze sank coldly.
hunks.sol: His gaze turned cold.

hunks.baseline: “You deceived everyone perfectly. You’ve never killed just once or twice in your life.”
hunks.sol: “You fooled everyone completely. That’s not the skill of a man who’s only killed once or twice.”

hunks.baseline: “Killing beasts doesn’t count as murder. People usually call it slaughter.”
hunks.sol: “Killing beasts doesn’t count as murder. Usually, it’s called slaughter.”

hunks.baseline: Every time I advanced slowly, the Black Hunters surrounding me in a semicircle took a step backward.
hunks.sol: Every time I advanced, the Black Hunters surrounding me in a semicircle retreated.

hunks.baseline: Even the dullest among them must have realized by now that I wasn’t simply an A-rank Hunter.
hunks.sol: Even the dullest among them must have realized by now that I wasn’t merely an A-rank Hunter.

hunks.baseline: They could feel the qualitatively different killing intent and the thick scent of blood clinging to me.
hunks.sol: They could feel the difference in my killing intent and the thick scent of blood clinging to me.

hunks.baseline: Im Yeongjun spoke with a stiff face.
hunks.sol: Im Yeongjun spoke, his face rigid.

hunks.baseline: “Taking out that D-rank Hunter was a warning. It was an order from above.”
hunks.sol: “Taking out that D-rank Hunter was a warning. The order came from above.”

hunks.baseline: “I understand what you mean. Stop here.”
hunks.sol: “I understand your position. Stop here.”

hunks.baseline: “The next one could be worse.”
hunks.sol: “The next warning could be worse.”

hunks.baseline: “Are you not worried about your mother and younger sibling?”
hunks.sol: “Aren’t you worried about your mother and younger sibling?”

hunks.baseline: For a moment, I couldn’t speak.
hunks.sol: The words caught in my throat.

hunks.baseline: My steady approach finally stopped, and Im Yeongjun’s voice gained strength.
hunks.sol: My slow but steady advance came to an abrupt stop, and strength returned to Im Yeongjun’s voice.

hunks.baseline: “I can negotiate with the people above us. I’ll serve as the stepping stone.”
hunks.sol: “I can negotiate with the people above us. I’ll act as the stepping stone between you.”

hunks.baseline: “You only have to give up one thing. Don’t live as A-rank Hunter Jin Taekyung. Live as a civilian named Jin Taekyung. Of course, you’ll be compensated generously for it.”
hunks.sol: “You only have to give up one thing. Stop living as A-rank Hunter Jin Taekyung and live as the civilian Jin Taekyung instead. Of course, you’ll be generously compensated.”

hunks.baseline: I gazed silently into Im Yeongjun’s eyes.
hunks.sol: I gazed into Im Yeongjun’s eyes.

hunks.baseline: There was wariness of me in them. At the same time, they were the eyes of a wolf constantly watching for an opening.
hunks.sol: They held wariness toward me, but they were also the eyes of a wolf constantly searching for an opening.

hunks.baseline: The corners of Im Yeongjun’s mouth began to rise slightly. I continued smoothly.
hunks.sol: The corners of Im Yeongjun’s mouth began to rise. I continued smoothly.

hunks.baseline: “Since you’re a stepping stone, I can just step lightly on you and pass over. I’ll find out who’s on the other side of the stream when I get there.”
hunks.sol: “Then I can step lightly on you and cross over. I’ll find out who’s waiting on the other side of the stream when I get there.”

hunks.baseline: They had crossed the line and had already become my enemies.
hunks.sol: They had crossed the line. They were already my enemies.

hunks.baseline: I placed the modern way and the way of Murim on opposite sides of a scale and agonized over the choice until the very end.
hunks.sol: The modern way and the way of Murim. I had weighed the two against each other and agonized over the choice until the very end…

hunks.baseline: “And you, asshole. When you make an offer like that, you should at least say it with eyes that look trustworthy.”
hunks.sol: “And listen, asshole. When you make an offer like that, try doing it with a more trustworthy look in your eyes.”

hunks.baseline: I heard his shout as I kicked off the ground.
hunks.sol: I kicked off the ground as he shouted.

hunks.baseline: The Black Hunters charged toward me with gritted teeth, and I brought my spear down at them.
hunks.sol: The Black Hunters charged at me with gritted teeth, and I brought my spear down upon them.

hunks.baseline: White Flame’s spearhead pierced through his chest and burst out the other side.
hunks.sol: White Flame’s spearhead pierced his chest and burst out through his back.

hunks.baseline: The mage behind the sturdy shield hurriedly stepped backward.
hunks.sol: The mage behind the sturdy shield hurriedly retreated.

hunks.baseline: Three blades rushed toward me with a fierce sound of splitting air. The faint Sword Energy gathering around them made it clear that they were A-rank Hunters.
hunks.sol: Three blades hurtled toward me with a fierce rush of air. Faint Sword Energy shimmered along their edges, marking their wielders as A-rank Hunters.

hunks.baseline: At that lightning-fast speed, all three swords shattered, and one of the men collapsed while clutching his throat.
hunks.sol: The three swords shattered beneath that lightning-fast strike, and one of the men collapsed clutching his throat.

hunks.baseline: As blood sprayed around me like a fountain, I released the spear.
I thrust both palms toward the two men trying to cut me down with their broken swords.
hunks.sol: Blood sprayed over me like a fountain. I released my spear and thrust both palms toward the other two men as they tried to cut me down with their broken swords.

hunks.baseline: The men struck in the chest by the Flame Divine Palm knelt as blood poured from their seven openings.
hunks.sol: The Flame Divine Palm struck them squarely in the chest, and they sank to their knees as blood poured from all seven orifices.

hunks.baseline: Their melted magical armor clung to their upper bodies and burned their flesh, but they were already dead before they had time to feel the pain.
hunks.sol: Their melted magical armor clung to their upper bodies and burned into their flesh, but they were dead before they could feel the pain.

hunks.baseline: I tilted my head slightly.
hunks.sol: I tilted my head.

hunks.baseline: An iron arrow thick and heavy enough to be called a small spear flew past me and embedded itself in the stone wall behind me.
hunks.sol: An iron arrow thick and heavy enough to pass for a small spear flew past me and buried itself in the stone wall behind me.

hunks.baseline: A cloud of dirt shot into the air as the arrow drove deep into the solid rock.
hunks.sol: A cloud of dirt erupted as the arrow drove deep into the solid rock.

hunks.baseline: It had tremendous power.
hunks.sol: Its power was tremendous.

hunks.baseline: *They’ve been irritating me for a while.*
hunks.sol: *They’ve been getting on my nerves for a while.*

hunks.baseline: These men also had the same basic positions as ordinary Hunters.
hunks.sol: Like ordinary Hunters, these men had a balanced distribution of roles.

hunks.baseline: They had tanks and mages, as well as melee damage dealers. Naturally, they couldn’t leave out ranged damage dealers.
hunks.sol: They had tanks, mages, and melee damage dealers. Naturally, they also had ranged damage dealers.

hunks.baseline: Three archers had never left the mansion. They had been constantly drawing their bows from the second-floor windows.
hunks.sol: Three archers had remained inside the mansion from the beginning, loosing arrow after arrow from the second-floor windows.

hunks.baseline: I clicked my tongue and was about to knock the arrow away with the shaft when the air wavered.
hunks.sol: I clicked my tongue and was about to knock the arrows aside with my spear shaft when the air rippled.

hunks.baseline: A black silhouette suddenly sprang out of it and tried to split my crown in two.
hunks.sol: A black silhouette burst from empty space and brought a dagger down to cleave my skull.

hunks.baseline: He was clearly a melee damage dealer with an excellent stealth-type Skill.
hunks.sol: He was clearly a melee damage dealer with an exceptional stealth-type Skill.

hunks.baseline: How many people had he killed with this tactic?
hunks.sol: How many people had he killed this way?

hunks.baseline: *Today, he picked the wrong person.*
hunks.sol: *Today, he picked the wrong target.*

hunks.baseline: I deftly twisted the spearhead.
hunks.sol: I twisted the spearhead with a deft motion.

hunks.baseline: The iron arrows, which should have been swept aside like fallen leaves, changed course and pierced the Black Hunter who had been trying to bury a dagger in my crown.
hunks.sol: The iron arrows that should have been swept aside like fallen leaves changed course and pierced the Black Hunter trying to bury a dagger in my skull.

hunks.baseline: Struck by arrows out of nowhere in midair, the Black Hunter fell with a heavy thud.
hunks.sol: Struck by arrows in midair, the Black Hunter crashed to the ground.

hunks.baseline: I pulled the iron arrows from his upper body. His body shuddered, then went still. At the same time, I flung the arrows hard in the direction they had come from.
hunks.sol: I pulled the iron arrows from his upper body. His body convulsed, then went still. At the same moment, I hurled the arrows back in the direction they had come from.

hunks.baseline: They flew back toward their original owners twice as fast and twice as powerfully as when they had first been fired.
hunks.sol: They returned to their original owners at least twice as fast and with twice the force.

hunks.baseline: The three archers, who had been nocking their next arrows, met death almost simultaneously.
hunks.sol: The three archers, who had been nocking their next arrows, died almost simultaneously.

hunks.baseline: The men who had been about to charge stopped when they saw the scene. I could see their hands trembling around their weapons.
hunks.sol: The men who had been about to charge stopped in their tracks. Their hands trembled around their weapons.

hunks.baseline: They had just watched more than ten of their comrades die before they could even blink.
hunks.sol: They had just watched more than ten of their comrades die in the blink of an eye.

hunks.baseline: But I had no intention of stopping.
hunks.sol: But I had no intention of stopping there.

hunks.baseline: I charged straight at them, cutting, stabbing, and smashing.
hunks.sol: I charged straight into them, cutting, stabbing, and smashing.

hunks.baseline: A mist of blood formed, and someone’s arms, legs, or head flew in every direction.
hunks.sol: Blood mist filled the air as arms, legs, and heads flew in every direction.

hunks.baseline: Screams erupted from all around.
hunks.sol: Screams erupted all around me.

hunks.baseline: Amid the terrified enemies, a knuckle wrapped in Fist Energy shot out and smashed into my spear shaft.
hunks.sol: From among the terrified enemies, a knuckle wrapped in Fist Energy shot out and slammed into my spear shaft.

hunks.baseline: I let out a short laugh at Im Yeongjun’s shout. He had bought them a brief moment.
hunks.sol: Im Yeongjun’s attack had bought them a brief moment. I let out a short laugh at his shout.

hunks.baseline: He was their leader for a reason. As expected, he was the best of them.
hunks.sol: He was their leader for a reason. As expected, he was the strongest among them.

hunks.baseline: One reason I considered Hunters so far inferior to martial artists was their method of handling qi.
hunks.sol: One reason Hunters seemed so inferior to martial artists was the way they handled qi.

hunks.baseline: *Even so, they’re only this good.*
hunks.sol: *Even so, this is as far as they go.*

hunks.baseline: No matter how high someone flew or how low they crawled, there were walls they could never cross.
hunks.sol: Some walls could never be crossed, no matter how high a person flew or how hard they struggled.

hunks.baseline: I punched toward the knuckle.
hunks.sol: I drove my fist toward the knuckle.

hunks.baseline: Im Yeongjun gritted his teeth and met my fist head-on.
hunks.sol: Refusing to back down, Im Yeongjun gritted his teeth and met my punch head-on.

hunks.baseline: The knuckle broke.
hunks.sol: The knuckle shattered.

hunks.baseline: A move from the Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist slammed into his shoulder.
hunks.sol: The first move of the Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist slammed into his shoulder.

hunks.baseline: His flesh melted and his bones were pulverized.
hunks.sol: His flesh melted, and his bones were pulverized.

hunks.baseline: It was as though a fire dragon had devoured his entire shoulder.
hunks.sol: A fire dragon devoured his entire shoulder.

hunks.baseline: Im Yeongjun spat blood and was sent flying into the distance.
hunks.sol: Im Yeongjun spat blood and flew backward.

hunks.baseline: The Black Hunters who had waited until the last moment quickly hoisted Im Yeongjun onto their backs and rushed into the mansion.
hunks.sol: The Black Hunters who had held back until the end quickly scooped up Im Yeongjun and rushed into the mansion.

hunks.baseline: Thud.
hunks.sol: Thud!

hunks.baseline: The door had barely closed when layer upon layer of transparent barriers wrapped around the mansion.
hunks.sol: The door had barely closed when layer upon layer of transparent barriers wrapped around the building.

hunks.baseline: It had to be an extremely powerful one. It even felt sturdier than the defensive magic Butler Kim had shown me before.
hunks.sol: It had to be an extremely powerful one. It felt even sturdier than the defensive magic Butler Kim had once shown me.

hunks.baseline: But I didn’t stop walking.
hunks.sol: But I didn’t stop.

hunks.baseline: I reached the door in a single step and punched the dozens of defensive barriers.
hunks.sol: One step carried me to the door. I punched the dozens of defensive barriers.

hunks.baseline: The Heaven-Destroying Divine Fist, unleashed with all my strength, hammered into the barriers.
hunks.sol: The Heaven-Destroying Divine Fist, unleashed with all my strength, hammered into them.

hunks.baseline: Just as it had shattered some nameless cliff on Mount Song, the Heaven-Destroying Divine Fist broke and crushed everything blocking its path.
hunks.sol: Just as it had shattered an unnamed cliff on Mount Song, the Heaven-Destroying Divine Fist broke and crushed everything blocking its path.

hunks.baseline: With a roar that sounded as though the sky itself were splitting apart, the defensive barriers were torn to shreds.
hunks.sol: With a roar like the sky splitting apart, the defensive barriers were torn to shreds.

hunks.baseline: The roof flew away, and the walls crumbled into ash.
hunks.sol: The roof flew off, and the walls turned to ash.

hunks.baseline: Through the melted front door, I saw the frozen enemies.
hunks.sol: Beyond the melted front door, I saw the enemies frozen in place.

hunks.baseline: Im Yeongjun stood at the center of them.
hunks.sol: Im Yeongjun stood at their center.

hunks.baseline: His jaw trembled. A single word, sounding almost like a groan, escaped between his lips soaked in blood.
hunks.sol: His jaw trembled. A single question escaped his blood-soaked lips like a groan.

hunks.baseline: So I had decided that, every once in a while, I would become a monster myself.
hunks.sol: So I had decided that, every once in a while, I would become one myself.
